title: Taxat Contract Observatory
subtitle: Search-first internal library for authoritative prose, live schemas, samples, validators, generated bindings, readiness posture, and task traceability.
summary: One search-first cabinet for the authoritative corpus, schema mirror, workspace-local schemas, bundled samples, validators, generated bindings, and current release-readiness posture.

lines: The observatory reads from 284 prose artifacts, 252 schemas, 52 bundled samples, and 81 roadmap task cards.
Current readiness verdict: ROLLBACK_SAFE. Binding parity: IN_SYNC.
Every page remains read-only, exposes source lineage, and keeps generated companions visibly subordinate to their authoritative inputs.
